item.title: Sault man pleads to assault causing bodily harm
item.description: A man pleaded guilty to assault causing bodily harm on Tuesday. The incident happened June 22, 2025, Ontario Court Justice Andrew Buttazzoni heard. item.title: Eddie Bauer to close Sault mall location
item.description: Clothing retailer Eddie Bauer is closing its Station Mall location. When Eddie Bauer LLC filed for bankruptcy protection in February, it said it would look to sell its stores while it liquidates its Canadian and American locations. The Station Mall location is one of 24 stores in Canada. Merchandise is 40 to 60 per cent […]

item.title: International Bridge traffic falls in February
item.description: Traffic crossing the International Bridge fell by nearly 10 per cent in February. The 54,121 crossings were down 9.2 per cent compared to February 2025 when 59,625 trips were recorded, Sault Ste. Marie Bride Authority says. Commuter fares made 28,691 crossings, or 53 per cent of all trips between the Twin Saults. Full-fare passenger cars […]

item.title: PUC offers wastewater plant tours to Sault residents
item.description: The public can tour the city’s wastewater treatment plant on March 20. Hours are 1 p.m. to 4:30 p.m. Tours run every 30 minutes at 2221 Queen St. E. Participants must pre-register with PUC Services. The tours are offered to help celebrate World Water Day.
